# `aitbc bridge unlock`

Refund or cancel a pending bridge transfer.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc bridge unlock [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--transfer-id` | text | — | yes | Transfer ID to refund |
| `--sender` | text | — | yes | Original sender address |
| `--signature` | text | — | no | Sender signature authorizing the unlock (hex); or use --wallet-name |
| `--wallet-name` | text | — | no | Wallet to sign the unlock with |
| `--wallet-password` | text | — | no | Password if the wallet is encrypted |
| `--rpc-url` | text | `http://localhost:8202/rpc` | no | Blockchain RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc bridge unlock --transfer-id <transfer_id> --sender <sender>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc bridge unlock --transfer-id <transfer_id> --sender <sender> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
